create_replay_buffer: create a uniformly sampled replay buffer with a given capacity for storing and sampling items
add_items_replay: add a sequence of items to the replay buffer, preallocating memory on first add
sample_replay_buffer: sample a minibatch of uniformly random indices from the replay buffer
reset_replay_buffer: reset the replay buffer by clearing all stored data and freeing preallocated memory
check_replay_stats: check the replay buffer size and fraction filled properties
